# Test fixture provenance

| File | Source | Version | SPDX | How |
|------|--------|---------|------|-----|
| `sc0-carol-6-8.sexp`, `sc0-chords-under-rests.sexp`, `sc0-jumps.sexp`, `sc0-key-change.sexp`, `sc0-keyboard.sexp`, `sc0-omr-result.sexp`, `sc0-pickup.sexp`, `sc0-repeats-voltas.sexp`, `sc0-satb.sexp`, `sc0-three-verses.sexp`, `sc1-open-score.sexp` | [score-protocol](https://github.com/egao1980/score-protocol) `tests/fixtures/`, hand-built scores in the canonical s-expression form (`sexp-to-score`). Where a header names a tune or text, it is a short public-domain one | score-protocol 0.2.0 | MIT | copied unchanged |

The other scores in the suite are generated by `tests/support.lisp` (`long-score`, `empty-score`). Expected timemap values in `tests/timemap-test.lisp` are worked out by hand from the rules in `src/timemap.lisp`; the arithmetic is written next to each row.
